body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; with Biomes! Caverns = living cavern.
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat (run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type (run #17); **BM variant mode is the sanctioned exception (USER-VERIFIED)**.
- **OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip**; hidden-valley breach notches preserve this.
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: `level == 1` gates must become "topmost level" if more levels land.
- **Pod transit handoff LATE**: HandoffTicksToImpact = 22.
- **DEPTH/HEIGHT CUES RETIRED (run #50)**: below view PLUMB, dim 0.06, hairlines, reveal.
- **Mesa model rejected**; stacked maps stay.
- **ALWAYS read `def.graphicData.Graphic`, never the stale `def.graphic` field** (run-53; lore).
- **Settings IMGUI discipline**: deferred tab/expando switches, snapshot-gated rows, maxOneColumn + measured heights + unconditional gutter.
- **Cross-level work migrates only for STRICTLY better-ranked work**; equal rank stays local (user-approved 2026-07-22). Async/actors/AOT rejected — main-thread sim only.
- **CrossLevelDemand skips Blueprint_Install** (fixed + verified run #62).
- **TEXTURE POLICY (2026-07-22, user-directed)**: user supplies ALL stair/ladder/elevator art. Stairs/grand/wide/ladders rotatable (Graphic_Multi); elevator NOT (Graphic_Single). Risers: vanilla/host-mod linked atlases on Conduits layer, no custom art.
- **Climb animations: vanilla pipeline only (2026-07-23, user-approved)**: native AnimationDef + BaseAnimationWorker; installed animation frameworks NOT used.

## JOB-SCAN SETTINGS TAB — BUILT 2026-07-23 (user-approved design), awaiting in-game check
New 6th settings tab "Job scanning" (inserted between Work and Combat; tab arrays now [6], per-tab reset + reset-all wired):
- **Presets** Relaxed(1/900/2400/900) / Default(2/450/1200/600) / Eager(4/250/600/300) / Frantic(8/120/300/150) setting the four sliders: `jobProbeBudget` (1-8/tick), `jobEmptyScanCooldown` (100-1500t), `jobMigrationCooldown` (300-3600t, BetterWorkCooldown keeps 3:4 ratio), `jobCacheTtl` (150-1500t). Tick sliders round to 10, labels show seconds.
- **Per-flow checkboxes**: `supplyConstruction` (gates WorkGiver_ABSupplyConstruction), `supplyBills` (gates AddBillNeeds), `supplyMeals` (gates AddMealNeeds), `fetchFromOtherLevels` (gates fetch giver).
- **Wire-throughs**: CrossLevelWork MigrationCooldownTicks/BetterWorkCooldownTicks/MaxProbesPerTick, LevelWorkSummary.TtlTicks, CrossLevelDemand.CacheTtlTicks, CrossLevelHaul.VerdictTtlTicks, both empty-scan cooldowns — all consts became `ABMod.Settings?.x ?? default` properties.
- **Event-driven wakeup (aggressiveness lever)**: postfix on `Blueprint.SpawnSetup` (declared method — never touches Thing.SpawnSetup) -> Notify_WorkChanged + new `CrossLevelDemand.Invalidate(map)`. Fresh blueprints pull builders/materials immediately instead of waiting out TTLs. Frame spawn intentionally NOT patched (Frame doesn't declare SpawnSetup; inherited-method patch would hit ALL things).
- Remaining brainstorm items NOT built (future): bill supply as Crafting/Cooking-work-type giver, demand-pressure cooldown scaling, "wanted elsewhere" overlay.

## 2026-07-23 TRANCHE 2 — BUILT, in-game check in progress (run launched with Achtung companion)
### Achtung! compat (ABAchtungCompat)
By-name prefix on `AchtungMod.Colonist.OrderTo(Vector3)`: pawn on directly linked level of viewed map -> stairs route (RouteThenRun + ABPendingOrders) + drafted Goto to formation slot on arrival. Per-pawn slot dedup. Same-map pawns pure Achtung; two-away + forced-work out of scope. Gates: ABDetect, ABGuard.Movement, crossLevelOrders.
### Meditation across levels (Patch_Meditate_CrossLevel) — user bug
Postfix JobGiver_Meditate.TryGiveJob: no assigned spot on own map + assigned MeditationSpot/throne elsewhere in column -> one hop toward it; vanilla +200 bias resolves on arrival. Own-map assigned spot stays vanilla's. 300t fail cooldown. Gates: crossLevelNeeds, ABGuard.Logistics.
### Construction supply deadlock (WorkGiver_ABSupplyConstruction) — user bug
Root cause: material push only in Hauling at lowest priority + builders can't descend (probe finds nothing doable). Fix: NonScan CONSTRUCTION giver (priorityInType 5): linked level's blueprint/frame need + local spare stack -> builder carries it down (AB_HaulAcrossLevels), then local scan finds build work. CrossLevelDemand gained constructionNeed sub-dict + constructionOnly param. Gates: crossLevelSupply+supplyConstruction, LowPowerWorker, 450t cooldown, VirtualScanActive guard.

## ART TUNER (2026-07-23) — BUILT, awaiting in-game use
"DEV: Adjust art" gizmo (ShowDevGizmos) on Building_ABStairs: live drawSize/per-facing offsets, def-wide apply all maps, **Bake all** -> Tools/ArtTuning.xml. WORKFLOW: tune -> bake -> agent folds into defs -> delete file.

## CLIMB/EMERGE ANIMATIONS + WIDE STAIRS (2026-07-23) — BUILT, awaiting in-game check
AB_Climb/AB_Emerge on Root node, procedural workers over ABClimbState snapshots (thread-safe). Step bob + lean (stairs), rung bob (ladders, `ladder` ext flag), slide onto stairwell, sink/shrink down, rise/grow up, 22t emerge. All three climb toils + StairTransfer. Elevators excluded. Janitor in ABGameComp; climbAnimations toggle. **Wide stairs**: AB_WideStairsDown/Up 2x1 rotatable, reuses stairs art at (2,1), climbFactor 0.8/150 stuff/6400 work.

## TEXTURE / ROTATION REWORK (2026-07-22) — user stair art dropped, tuning pending
Clean Graphic_Multi base paths; riser graphics on host atlases (PowerConduit/SewagePipe/ChemfuelPipes/oilPipe/PSTransmitter). WATCH: no magenta stubs for foreign texPaths at sync.

## MECH ESCORT CROSS-LEVEL FOLLOW — BUILT 2026-07-22, awaiting check
Postfix JobGiver_AIFollowOverseer.TryGiveJob -> stairs toward overseer's level; arrival re-runs. 250t cooldown.

## PRIORITY-AWARE CROSS-LEVEL WORK — USER-VERIFIED run #62 (both directions)
Tier 1 idle + Tier 2 strictly-better rank (WorkGiversInOrderNormal index, truncated probe). Perf: LevelWorkSummary (TTL now settings-driven) + ~17 detectors fail-open; event invalidation (designations + NEW blueprints); VersionedCooldown; probe budget (now settings); 1200t (now settings) migration cooldown.

## MISC. ROBOTS COMPAT — USER-VERIFIED run #62
5 AIRobot return givers postfixed; LowPowerWorker guard; ToolUser float menu.

## SETTINGS + GEN-CONTROL SUITE (2026-07-22) — BUILT; now SIX tabs (gen/view/work/jobs/combat/advanced)
Measured scrolls, presets, ABGuard panel + Re-arm, gen knobs + live preview, Odyssey sky landmarks, climbAnimations checkbox.

## Below-view rendering (USER-VERIFIED). COMPAT (USER-VERIFIED): sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode.
## PARITY TRANCHE COMPLETE; pod transit + AA verified #39. 2026-07-21: stair routing, BC caverns, naturalistic peaks, camera level lock.

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell; cap corner fillers; DEV: Adjust art.

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select in place; bidirectional right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Better Mountains + Medieval Overhaul (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots + Robots++ (verified). Achtung! formation drags (soft, untested). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: job-scan settings tab + wire-throughs + blueprint-spawn wakeup BUILT (compile green) — NOT in the currently running test session (launched before this build); needs relaunch to check. Also awaiting check: Achtung drags, meditation redirect, construction supply, climb animations, wide stairs, art tuner. Outstanding: art bake fold-in, remaining brainstorm levers (bill-supply work-type giver, pressure scaling, overlay), mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
